facts: In autumn 1939 the Soviet Union demanded that Finland move its border on the Karelian Isthmus back from Leningrad and give up land for Soviet bases. Finland refused. On 30 November 1939 Soviet bombers hit Helsinki and the Red Army invaded. Outnumbered, Finland's soldiers fought on through a very cold winter, captured Soviet tanks and held for more than three months. In March 1940 Finland signed a peace and gave up about a tenth of its land, but stayed independent.

lines.say: In autumn 1939, the Soviet Union demanded that Finland push its border back and give up land for Soviet bases. Finland refused.
On November 30th, Soviet bombers hit Helsinki and the Red Army invaded.
Outnumbered, Finland's soldiers fought on through one of the coldest winters in memory.
They captured Soviet tanks, and held the Red Army for more than three months.
In March, Finland signed a peace and gave up a tenth of its land. But it stayed independent.
